notes.title: [Event] NextFest Celebration Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046359/8b7b82d509b3c2882c85443a164813f7a3acb538.png[/img]

A love comedy about conquering Earth with Seah, a space beauty!
The visual novel <Winter Girl> will be joining you at this October's Next Fest.

Download the demo version of Winter Girl and meet Seah and Lumi!
You can enjoy the experience of Winter Girl before its release.
This demo version covers the initial process of meeting Seah.

If you like the game, please leave your feedback through the official Discord or Steam community!


[h2]Steam Next Fest Event[/h2]
After playing through the entire demo version, please write a review for the <Winter Girl> demo, add it to your wishlist, and fill out the form below.
Five people will be selected through a drawing to receive a "Steam Wallet code 10$" 

➡️https://forms.gle/2JZZS94jaQ82cXVn8

The drawing will take place after Next Fest ends, and we will contact the winners individually. 
We will announce the winners later.
